title: STARR-seq Library Preparation
protocol: Sonicate 5 μg of BAC/genomic DNA in 130 μl TE using Covaris microTUBE with AFA fiber.
For a target size of 1000-1500bp, sonicate for 15 seconds per sample at intensity parameters: 2-4-200.
For a target size of 500-750bp, sonicate for 45 seconds per sample at intensity parameters: 5-3-200.
Place samples on ice after sonication.
Pool all sonication samples and add the corresponding volume of 6x DNA loading dye.
Run 60 μl sample per well (up to 20 wells total) on a 1% agarose gel at 140V for 20-30 minutes.
Size-select DNA between 1 kb and 1.5 kb from the gel.
Purify size-selected DNA from two lanes per column using Gel Extraction Kit.
Do not use more than 400 mg of agarose per column.
Ensure that the gel slice is completely dissolved at 25°C under constant agitation for 10-15 minutes.
Elute purified DNA in 50 μl EB, repeat elution with eluate.
Pool the elution fractions of five columns and purify again using QIAquick PCR Purification Kit.
Elute final purified DNA in 50 μl EB, repeat elution with eluate.
Determine DNA concentration for adapter ligation reaction (1 μg of fragmented and purified BAC/gDNA per reaction).
Use 1 µg DNA starting material per reaction for adapter ligation.
Perform 1 adapter ligation reaction for focused libraries and 5 reactions for genome-wide libraries.
Mix 90 µl of adaptor-ligation reaction with PCR strip.
Add 1.8 vol beads (162 µl) to 1 vol DNA (90 µl), vortex, pipette up and down 20x.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature for 10 min.
Place PCR strip onto magnetic stand; incubate 10 min on magnet until solution is clear.
Remove all liquid from tubes.
Wash beads twice with 250 µl of 80% EtOH, incubating for 2 min each time.
Air dry beads at room temperature with open lids on magnet until cracks appear.
Elute the sample with 100 µl RNase-free H2O and place strip in a thermo cycler at 37°C for 3 min.
Clean up the eluate using AMPure XP beads by adding 0.8 vol. of beads to 1 vol. DNA.
Elute the cleaned-up DNA in a final volume of 20 µl EB.
Pool all 5 cleaned-up adaptor ligation reactions for genome-wide library prior to amplification.
Perform PCR with 7 cycles using KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix, primers, and adapter-ligated DNA.
Perform PCR with 9 cycles using KAPA HiFi HotStart ReadyMix, primers, and adapter-ligated DNA.
Heat PCR reaction at 98°C for 45 seconds.
Perform 5 cycles of heating at 98°C for 15 seconds, cooling at 65°C for 30 seconds, and heating at 72°C for 45 seconds.
Perform 9 additional cycles as specified in the previous step.
Conduct a final elongation at 72°C for 60 seconds.
Prepare an agarose gel and perform gel analysis using 10 µl of PCR product mixed with 2 µl of 6x DNA loading dye from each test PCR.
Amplify adapter-ligated genomic DNA library inserts using the determined number of cycles in 30 separate PCR reactions or use 4 reactions for focused libraries based on test PCR results.
Pool either 4 or 10 PCR reactions into DNA LoBind Tubes (Eppendorf) with a volume of 1.5 ml.
Purify the pooled sample using AMPure XP beads, applying 0.8 volumes of beads per volume of PCR reaction.
Elute purified DNA in 40 µl or 100 µl of EB buffer based on bead usage volume.
Add 5 volumes of PB buffer to 1 volume of PCR product and mix thoroughly.
Apply the sample up to a maximum of 700 µl onto a QIAquick column and centrifuge at 18,000g for 60 seconds to bind DNA.
Discard the flow-through from the previous step and return the QIAquick column to its tube.
Add 0.75 ml of PE buffer to the QIAquick column and centrifuge again at 18,000g for 60 seconds to wash.
Remove any remaining PE buffer by placing the QIAquick column back into a clean collection tube and spinning at maximum speed for 2 minutes.
Place each QIAquick column in a clean 1.5 ml microcentrifuge tube.
Add 50 µl EB to the center of the QIAquick membrane for elution.
Centrifuge for 1 min at maximum speed.
Re-apply eluate to column and centrifuge again.
Determine DNA concentration.
Incubate 2h, 37°C in PCR machine.
Heat inactivate for 20 min at 65°C.
Add 10 µl of 6x DNA loading dye to digested plasmid DNA.
Run 60 µl samples per lane on a 1% agarose gel at 160V for 30 min.
Cut out the digested plasmid (~3 kb) from gel under blue light with SYBR® Safe DNA Gel Stain.
Purify digested plasmid DNA from two lanes per column using QIAquick Gel Extraction Kit, Qiagen.
Wash 2x with 700 µl PE buffer.
Elute 2x (50 µl & 25 µl) EB.
Pool eluates from gel extraction step and divide into two samples with equal volumes.
Clean up each sample with a QIAquick column.
Elute 2x (50 μl and 25 μl) EB using MinElute PCR purification.
Pool eluates from the PCR purification step and divide into two samples with equal volume.
Clean up with 2 MinElute columns.
Elute 2x (15 μl and 15 μl) EB.
Set up In-Fusion HD cloning reactions for a genome-wide library using a 2:1 molar ratio of insert to plasmid.
Incubate each reaction mixture at 50°C for 15 minutes in a PCR machine.
Place samples on ice after incubation.
Pool 4 cloning reactions (total of ~40 μl) if not pooled already.
Adjust pooled cloning reactions to 250 μl with EB.
Add 25 μl 3M NaAc pH 5.2 and vortex thoroughly.
Add 2 μl Pellet Paint and vortex again.
Add 750 μl ice-cold (-20°C) 100% EtOH, mix well by vortexing.
Incubate at -20°C for 16 hours.
Spin samples at full speed for 15 minutes at 4°C.
Vortex the samples.
Centrifuge again for 15 minutes at full speed and 4°C.
Carefully aspirate supernatant.
Wash with 750 μl ice-cold -20°C 70% EtOH.
Mix by inverting the tube or vortexing.
Spin for 15 min at full speed at 4°C.
Carefully aspirate the supernatant.
Dry the pellet for 30 sec at 37°C, further dry until completely dry at room temperature.
Resuspend the pellet of cloning reaction in 12.5 μl EB by pipetting followed by vortexing.
Incubate for 1-3 h at -80°C to increase transformation efficiency.
Store at -20°C or proceed with transformation after freezing and thawing on ice.
Pre-warm 12 L (or 4 L) LB medium at 37°C.
Pre-warm recovery medium at 37°C.
Use pre-cooled 20 μl tips (-20°C) to pipet competent cells.
Perform all steps on ice, ideally in a cold room.
Pre-cool DNA LoBind Tubes 1.5 ml and cuvettes on ice.
Pool eluates of cloning reactions (e.g., 5 x 12.5 μl).
Thaw 5 tubes (or 1 tube) of electrocompetent E. coli MegaX DH10B™ T1R on ice.
Distribute 2.5 μl aliquots of pooled DNA to pre-cooled LoBind Tubes 1.5 ml.
Pipette 1 μl transformation control pUC19 to pre-cooled LoBind Tubes 1.5 ml.
Add 20 μl MegaX DH10B to each tube.
Pipette DNA-bacteria mix into pre-cooled cuvettes using pre-cooled 20 µl tips.
Electroporate at 2 kV, 25µF, 200 ohms with Bio-Rad Gene PulserxCell.
Immediately add 1 ml of pre-warmed (37°C) recovery medium.
Recover transformed bacteria in 14 ml polypropylene round bottom tubes while shaking (>300 rpm) for 1 h at 37°C.
Pool all transformations (~22-23 ml).
Make a dilution series of pooled bacteria culture from transformation reaction and transformation control to determine efficiency.
Dilute 100 µl bacteria culture with 900 µl LB medium (1:10).
Dilute 200 µl from 1:10 dilution with 800 µl LB medium (1:50).
Dilute 100 µl from 1:50 dilution with 900 µl LB medium (1:500).
Dilute 100 µl from 1:500 dilution with 900 µl LB medium (1:5000).
Plate 100 µl of 1:50, 1:500 and 1:5000 dilutions on Ampicillin selection plates (100 µg/ml).
Add equal volumes (~1.8 ml) of bacteria culture from pooled transformation reactions to 2L of pre-warmed (37°C) LB medium with Ampicillin (100 µg/ml) in 5 L Erlenmeyer flasks.
Incubate overnight (~13 h) while shaking (200 rpm) at 37°C.
Measure OD600 (OD600 should be between 2 - 2.6).
Spin down bacteria culture in 1L bottles, 45 min, 4200 rpm, 4°C.
Decant supernatant (leave small volume of medium).
Resuspend bacteria pellets in remaining medium by vortexing.
Pool resuspended pellets into one bottle.
Use 10-15 ml of LB medium per 4 bottles to clean out remaining pellet remains.
Unite everything with resuspended pellets and vortex to obtain a homogenous bacteria suspension.
Distribute bacteria suspension evenly into 8 (or up to 10) 50 ml falcon tubes before determining weight of empty tubes.
Spin for 15 min at 6000g at 4°C.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Determine the weight of bacteria pellets in falcon tubes.
Store pellets at -20°C.
Use one pellet (maximum 7.5 g) and follow the protocol for the Plasmid Plus Giga Kit.
Elute with 1 ml H2O, measure concentration.
If concentration is > 2 µg/µl, add elution to the first elution; if < 2 µg/µl, discard it and continue only with the first elution.
